name: bidstream
description: BidStream — AI agent that auctions a task among competing LLM providers via HTTP 402 bids and settles the winner on XRPL.

scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n agent,openai,anthropic,gemini -c blue,green,magenta,yellow "tsx watch src/agent/server.ts" "tsx watch src/providers/openai/index.ts" "tsx watch src/providers/anthropic/index.ts" "tsx watch src/providers/gemini/index.ts"
